newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Freegold output seen down, other mines up.
newsitem.headline: Freegold output seen down, other mines up.

text.p: Anglo American Corp of South Africa Ltd said on Thursday it expected gold production at Free State Consolidated Gold Mines Ltd to fall 6.4 percent to 78 tonnes in 1997, but other mines in its stable should produce more.

Vaal Reefs Exploration and Mining Co Ltd should produce 70 tonnes, four percent more than in 1996, while Western Deep Levels Ltd was likely to produce 36 tonnes, seven percent more than in 1996, the company said.
Anglo put Elandsrand Gold Mining Co Ltd 1997 output at 16 tonnes, down three percent on last year, with East Rand Gold and Uranium Co Ltd output flat at 12.3 tonnes.
